teaser: My books stall at 60 to 95%; these articles do not. The hypothesis: a book is an ordered set of finished articles, tested by Web Summit in November.
core_idea: Books stall because they are one big batch: the first version locks the content, review piles up on one person, and the energy moves on; the newsroom's articles are small, finished, linked and read, with a feedback loop; so a book can be a curated, ordered set of finished articles plus the editorial thread, and the test is to have books on agents, graphs, Portugal and making books for Web Summit in Lisbon, 9 to 12 November, via KDP author copies.
